steps.en: Install the library and its TransformerLens dependency
steps.zh: 安装这个库及其 TransformerLens 依赖

steps.en: Load a model plus harmful/harmless datasets
steps.zh: 加载模型以及有害／无害数据集

steps.en: Caches residual-stream activations for N harmful and N harmless samples
steps.zh: 缓存 N 条有害与 N 条无害样本的残差流激活

steps.en: Derives a difference-of-means refusal direction per hook point
steps.zh: 为每个 hook 点算出均值差拒答方向

steps.en: Score candidate directions against the test set
steps.zh: 用测试集给候选方向打分

steps.en: Patches the chosen direction into the weights
steps.zh: 把选中的方向写进权重

value.en: You get to search and compare refusal directions yourself, without rebuilding the activation-caching scaffolding
value.zh: 你能自己搜索并比较拒答方向，而不用重写激活缓存的脚手架

sources: FailSpy/abliterator README.md: ModelAbliterator(...), cache_activations(N=…), refusal_dirs(), test_dir(testing_dir, N=32), apply_refusal_dirs([...], layers=None), mse_harmless(N=…), save_activations('file.pth'), blacklist_layer(…); requirements.txt pins transformer-lens from a git @dev branch
